verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents some built-in background behaviors: rules can be scheduled and ramped (docs-22, ramp schedules in docs-16), safe rollouts and multi-arm bandits are listed as plan features (docs-31), and stale flags are detected automatically (docs-4). These are narrow, preconfigured feature-flag and experiment automations rather than general user-defined or AI-driven background workflows. Missing for 10: user-configurable autonomous automations or agents (the MCP server is interactive only, and no triggers, webhooks or scheduled jobs are evidenced), detail on how these automations run unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
